ruleDefinitions.name: Custom File Open Handler Executes PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the abuse of custom file open handler, executing powershell Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*shell\\\\open\\\\command\\\\.*") AND (Details = RGX(".*powershell.*") AND Details = RGX(".*\\-command.*")))
